scope: Live production Astra transport on preserved synthetic print runs, with deliberately different draft settings. No geometry, setup, study or run is changed; no new solve or physical validation.

request.message: For this saved run only, explain how wall and skin volumes were estimated, which infill density belongs to it, and whether support material is included. Do not propose changes.

assumptions: Print stiffness is a homogenized equivalent solid, not an explicit infill mesh or sliced toolpath.
Perimeter and skin volumes use actual layer contours, including internal holes and local top/bottom surfaces.
Shell and core fractions are homogenized throughout the body; the spatial stiffness of individual walls and infill is not resolved.
Layering is transversely isotropic: print Z is the weak/layer direction after the supplied rotation.
gyroid core factors are illustrative (in-plane 0.82, layer 0.72), not coupon-calibrated.
Filament modulus, strength and density remain user inputs. No printed-specimen calibration is claimed.
Additional raster-scale anisotropy, local voids, bonding defects and moisture are not modelled.
Layer contours use nominal line width and layer height; bead overlap, variable extrusion widths, gap fill and toolpaths are not modeled.

response.message:
This saved run used layer-contours-v1: wall and skin volumes were estimated from actual layer contours, including holes and local top/bottom surfaces, across 187 layers at the recorded rotation [30°, 45°, 20°]. Settings were 3 walls, 0.4 mm line width, 0.2 mm layer height, and 4 top/4 bottom layers. Recorded wall volume was 1,399.47 mm³; skin volume was effectively zero (1.29 × 10⁻¹³ mm³).

The run used 35% gyroid infill—not the currently displayed 90%. Estimated part filament usage was 2,029.66 mm³ (2.52 g), excluding supports, adhesion and purge. These are nominal contour-based estimates, not sliced toolpath measurements; current draft controls do not change the saved run.

assumptions: Print stiffness is a homogenized equivalent solid, not an explicit infill mesh or sliced toolpath.
Walls and top/bottom skins are estimated from the axis-aligned box of the oriented part.
Layering is transversely isotropic: print Z is the weak/layer direction after the supplied rotation.
gyroid core factors are illustrative (in-plane 0.82, layer 0.72), not coupon-calibrated.
Filament modulus, strength and density remain user inputs. No printed-specimen calibration is claimed.

response.message:
This saved run records a bounding-box estimate: walls and top/bottom skins were estimated from the axis-aligned box of the oriented part, not actual layer contours. Its geometry_method field is unavailable, but its recorded assumptions explicitly identify this method.

The recorded settings use 3 walls × 0.4 mm = 1.2 mm nominal wall thickness, and 4 layers × 0.2 mm = 0.8 mm for each top/bottom skin. The combined shell fraction is 26.61%; separate wall and skin volumes are unavailable.

This run used 20% gyroid infill and rotation [30°, 45°, 20°]. The current 90% draft infill does not change the saved result.

Recorded part usage is 1,321.3 mm³ of filament (1.638 g). Supports, adhesion and purge are excluded.
